description: Update the Terms of Service enforcement settings: whether logged-in users must accept the terms (tos_for_users) and whether the terms apply to public shares (tos_on_public_shares). Requires the configured Nextcloud user to be an admin.

tosForUsers.description: Require logged-in users to accept the terms

tosOnPublicShares.description: Apply the terms to public shares

title: Update Terms Settings
